events.verdict: Jokic (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position on Wade (MIA) during the drive and cleanly dislodges the ball.
Beasley (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position on Waiters (MIA) during the drive.
Jokic (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position during the play at the basket by Adebayo (MIA).
Adebayo (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Murray (DEN).
[Observable in enhanced video] Richardson (MIA) takes more than two steps after he has gathered the ball.
Winslow (MIA) and Millsap (DEN) engage and separate during the rebound,
[Observable in enhanced video] Wade (MIA) fails to fully clear and remains in the lane with his foot on the lane line for longer than three seconds without actively guarding an opponent.
Richardson (MIA) briefly grasps the jersey of Millsap (DEN) in the post but doesn't affect his ability to make his intended pass.
Winslow (MIA) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.

[Observable in enhanced video] Murray (DEN) gathers the ball on his right foot and then establishes his left foot as his pivot foot. Murray lifts his pivot foot slightly before releasing the ball at the start of his dribble.
Winslow (MIA) makes contact to the body of Murray (DEN) on the drive that affects his SQBR.
Jokic (DEN) splits his feet before he starts his dribble.
Murray (DEN) makes marginal contact with Richardson (MIA) at the start of his drive, but he is able to move through the contact and maintain his dribble.
Murray (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Richardson (MIA) and cleanly dislodges the ball.
Winslow (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position when he ties up the loose ball with Beasley (DEN) and a jump ball is correctly whistled.
Winslow (MIA) grabs Beasley's (DEN) right arm and affects his ability to get to the jump ball.

Beasley (DEN) and Winslow (MIA) are simultaneously making contact with the ball when the Nuggets signal for a timeout. Officials correctly whistle the held ball and the Nuggets are not awarded a timeout.
Beasley (DEN) briefly places his hands on the opposite side hips of Waiters (MIA) but the contact does not affect Waiters' SQBR.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Beasley (DEN) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Murray (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position on Richardson (MIA) during the drive.
Murray (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position during the play at the basket by Adebayo (MIA).
Adebayo (MIA) is in the paint for about 3 seconds when he receives the ball and immediately shoots.

Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Richardson (MIA) and puts his hands to the body of Richardson but does not deliver contact or affect Richardson's ability to defend.
Adebayo (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position during the play at the basket by Jokic (DEN).
Richardson (MIA) commits a take foul on Murray (DEN).
